result.title: GeoScope: Training-Free Program Execution beyond the Counting Horizon for Ultra-High-Resolution Remote Sensing Question Answering
result.comment: Preprint. 72 pages including the Supplementary Material. Project page: https://avalon-s.github.io/GeoScope/
result.summary: In ultra-high-resolution (UHR) remote sensing images, the objects that questions count in a region or relate by direction often span only a few pixels. Existing methods mainly decide where a vision-language model (VLM) should look and trust its answer in the chosen view. We show that this assumption fails for counting, and measure VLMs as one calibrates a sensor. All eight open VLMs tested fall increasingly short once a view holds more than a certain number of objects, about five for most on DOTA aerial images. This counting horizon narrows as views grow and objects appear smaller. An empirical power-law response model predicts the undercount a split recovers and the spurious counts it adds, and supports the rule of splitting only views beyond the horizon. In GeoScope, a text-only language model parses the question into a typed spatial program that fixes the region and its resolution. The VLM only grounds and counts within its operating range, and directions are computed explicitly from the grounded boxes. To our knowledge, it is the first UHR method to split views by a measured limit of the VLM. Without training, it improves Qwen3-VL-8B by 16.3 points on regional counting and 10.5 on spatial relations in XLRS-Bench, and has the highest reported accuracy, trained methods included, on regional counting and on the whole benchmark by question. On UHR-Micro it improves global and regional counting by 16.8 and 36.2 points, 15.6 of the former from splitting. On MME-RealWorld counting it gains 11.4 points, and we show that an option that is almost never correct yet often chosen distorts comparisons there. Project page: https://avalon-s.github.io/GeoScope/

AI.brief_summary: 论文在超高分辨率遥感图像中测量 VLM 的计数能力上限（「counting horizon」），并用幂律响应模型预测少计与虚计，进而提出免训练的 GeoScope：由纯文本 LLM 将问题解析为带类型空间程序，VLM 仅在其工作范围内定位与计数，超出上限的视图才拆分，方向关系由框显式计算。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接关系到「该看哪里」与「何时停止/拆分」的收益成本权衡，其对单视图容量上限的量化与「只有在超限时才拆分」的规则，可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、动态计算与停止决策，以及容量–分辨率之间的信息瓶颈；无需生成 latent 亦可提供对照基线。
